_help._file: How we PROVE each personality feels like itself: its behaviour, measured by meters (src/ai/meters.ts — meterNames has every meter's plain-English name) and averaged over many games (≥ 300 mixed games at First Class). Thresholds are starting guesses from design/ai.md; the Personality Check tunes them.
_help.personalities: Per personality: a list of checks. meter = which meter (its average per game) · op = the test · value = the number for >= / <= / nearAverage · label = what players would say it means.
_help.op: >= / <= : the meter's average must be at least / at most `value`. tableBest / tableWorst : the highest / lowest average of all personalities at the table. nearAverage : within `value` of the table's average. neverExtreme (meter "*") : not the table's highest or lowest on any meter. beats (with against) : its share of the wins in games with that rival is at least `value` — the rock-paper-scissors edges (Scholar > Survivor > Strategist > Scholar).
_help.all: Checks every personality must pass. check = which test · min / max = its band · label = what it means.

Scholar.label: beats the Survivor (out-spells a cautious player) — rock-paper-scissors
longest average word at the table
gets its glyphlings hemmed in often (it can't see traps coming)

Survivor.label: beats the Strategist (it can't be caught) — rock-paper-scissors
tangled least often at the table
most room to move at the table

Strategist.label: beats the Scholar (hems the speller in) — rock-paper-scissors
tangles a rival in at least 60% of games
ends at least half its turns within 2 hexes of a rival glyphling
cuts the most rival moves per turn at the table

all.label: the tell-apart grid recognises it from its meters at least 70% of the time
its Archmage beats its Apprentice at least 75% of the time
calls the game itself in some games (calledIt average above 0)
…and is wrong some of those times (calledIt but not calledItRight)
